ticket.notes: Three-leg ultra-safe hybrid accumulator ticket constructed under Model 4.0 (roys_betting_engine_BTS_O2-5_win) and selection_process.md (Section 4 Step 3: Automated 3-Leg Safety Trigger Archetype B). Designed specifically for international FIFA-break slate conditions where major Tier 1 leagues are on pause. Features FC Masar vs Tersana SC Over 1.5 Goals (@ 1.40, 78.0% Model Prob, +6.6pp Value Edge, EV +0.092), Aurora FC vs Deportivo Mixco Over 1.5 Goals (@ 1.26, 83.0% Model Prob, +3.6pp Value Edge, EV +0.046), and CD Águila vs CD Municipal Limeño Over 1.5 Goals (@ 1.20, 85.0% Model Prob, DCI 0.571, +1.7pp Value Edge). Combined odds: 2.12 vs compound probability 55.0% (break-even 47.2%, cumulative value edge +7.8pp, ticket EV +0.166).

selections.comment: Main Ticket Leg 1. Value Anchor selection under Model 4.0 Section 3.1 Tier 1 Corridor. League leaders FC Masar (1st, 22 pts) host 10th-place Tersana SC at Right to Dream Stadium. Masar has generated high home offensive volume (1.83 GF/G), scoring multiple goals in key fixtures (4-2 vs Pharco, 3-1 vs El Dakhlia), while Tersana scores and concedes 1.20 away. At 1.40 odds, Over 1.5 offers a standout +6.6pp value edge and +0.092 EV, serving as the high-yield anchor of the 3-leg hybrid accumulator.
selections.notes: Egyptian Second Division A Round 12 clash. Masar is unbeaten at home this season.

selections.comment: Main Ticket Leg 2. High-Safety Over 1.5 Anchor under Model 4.0 Section 3.1. Aurora FC at Estadio Cementos Progreso scores 1.75 goals/game and has won 7 of 9 home matches. Deportivo Mixco suffers from catastrophic road defense, conceding 20 goals in 9 away matches (2.22 GA/G). The reverse fixture produced 5 goals (Mixco 3-2 Aurora). With an 83.0% model probability at 1.26 odds, Over 1.5 safely bypasses Mixco's counter-attack threat while capturing positive EV (+0.046).

selections.comment: Main Ticket Leg 3. High-Floor Safety Anchor. CD Águila at Estadio Juan Francisco Barraza is a high-scoring juggernaut, scoring 21 goals in 8 home matches (2.63 GF/G). Municipal Limeño plays an aggressive road style, scoring and conceding 1.50 goals/game away. DCI is 0.571, proving bilateral scoring dynamics. At 1.20 odds, Over 1.5 carries an 85.0% probability, insulating the ticket against binary match winner variance while completing the 3-leg hybrid accumulator at 2.12 combined odds.
